title: Analyzing Toxicity in Deep Conversations: A Reddit Case Study
reasoning: The paper examines the propagation of toxicity in Reddit conversations, using subreddits like r/atheism as part of its data source. Although the analysis includes examples of religious-themed profanity and toxicity, the research focuses on conversational dynamics and the dissemination of toxic language rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, faith, morals, or ethics.
